draft.reply:
Hi there,

You can add your coworker as an Editor in just a few steps:

1. Go to Settings > Members > Invite
2. Enter their email address
3. Choose the "Editor" role from the role dropdown

They'll receive an email invitation to join your workspace, so just make sure they accept it within 7 days, as invites expire after that.

Let us know if you run into any issues!
